summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.total: sums the tenant's approved entries (refunds included as negatives) and rounds to 2 dp away from zero (DF-FXL-0007). Implemented per RQ-FXL-0003.

criteria.test: total rounds a positive half-cent away from zero
total rounds a negative half-cent away from zero

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved entries and other tenants
total includes refunds as negative amounts

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.approve using FxIdentity.Identity.isActive and hasRole, checking in the order of RQ-FXL-0004 with the RQ-FXL-0104 amendment (entries above 10,000 also need Admin). Only Approved and ApprovedBy change on success. fx-identity was not modified.

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve
criteria.test: approve accepts a session idle for exactly 15 minutes

criteria.criterion: At 15 minutes 1 second the session gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve rejects a session idle for 15 minutes and 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Admin without the Approver role

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: an Approver without Admin approving an entry of 10,000.01 gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve rejects an Approver without Admin for an amount above 10000

criteria.criterion: RQ-FXL-0104: an entry of exactly 10,000 needs only Approver
criteria.test: approve accepts an amount of exactly 10000 with only the Approver role

criteria.criterion: An entry of another tenant is reported as NotFound
criteria.test: approve reports an entry of another tenant as NotFound

criteria.criterion: Approving an entry created by the session user gives SelfApproval
criteria.test: approve rejects approving an entry the session user created

criteria.criterion: Approving an already approved entry gives AlreadyApproved
criteria.test: approve rejects an entry that is already approved

summary: Implemented FxLedger.Ledger.view: SessionExpired when the session is not active (isActive), otherwise the session tenant's entries in original order. No role widens the tenant filter (RQ-FXL-0006, DF-FXL-0005).

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries, in original order
criteria.test: view returns only the session tenant's entries in original order
view returns SessionExpired for an expired session

summary: Not implemented. convertCurrency needs an exchange-rate source, which is not chosen: DF-FXL-0009 is draft and RQ-FXL-0008 is proposed with no acceptance criteria and no rounding or rate-date rules. The stub is unchanged and no rates were invented. Unblock by accepting DF-FXL-0009 and specifying RQ-FXL-0008.

criteria.criterion: convertCurrency converts amounts between ISO 4217 currencies using the source chosen in DF-FXL-0009
Rounding and rate date for conversions are specified (RQ-FXL-0008)
